name: Pyramid of the Moon
scope: Whole surviving Pyramid of the Moon, its receding worn masonry tiers, summit, central upper stair flights and intrinsic projecting stepped talud-tablero front platform with axial stair. Preserve complete native outline including projections and irregular rear notch. Exclude separate plaza pyramids/altars, Pyramid of the Sun, Palace of Quetzalpapálotl, avenue, mountains, trees, visitors, temporary access barriers and interiors.
era: Surviving reconstructed/worn masonry exterior informed by exact published 2007 Syced and 2015 Goose friend own CC0 photographs; no ideal ancient temple/stucco reconstruction or claim of surveyed 2026 surface condition.

review.method: Five exact published own CC0 originals individually inspected; native whole-pyramid/ledge/stair controls and primary INAH text
review.notes: Qualla-first 31 families, zero source conflicts and zero next1000 candidate/member/alias/Q29240/way148480246 conflicts. Five existing published own CC0 originals (Syced 2007 images5/6/10/11 and Goose friend2015) individually inspected and exact native SHA1-bound; unchanged published policy passed. Syced14/15 depict Pyramid of the Sun and are excluded without pixel use. Gorgo template-only PD candidate not adopted. No metadata, category, body or policy changes. No supplemental imagery required so far. Goose friend image is strongly posterized and supplies topology only; natural stone palette follows Syced originals. Four whole frontal-oblique views and one close view support main tiers, upper stair runs, talud-tablero front platform and stone ledges. No protected official photos/plans viewed or adopted.
